items.title: Other Business
notes: During Other Business Committee discussed the Doon Pioneer Village re-opening event and inquired into whether or not the two dollar admission fee could be waived. Committee also inquired into the possibility of having the event operate under a pay what you can model for admission. Committee directed staff to return to the May Council meeting with a report that provided further information and for options on admission models for the re-opening event.

items.title: N. Salonen motion from budget re: WRHN special levy
notes:
Councillor Salonen introduced the motion and explained how the motion had been referred to Committee from the 2026 budget cycle. Councillor Salonen then moved a referral motion for this proposed addition to the levy to be included in the 2027 budget process.

Committee discussed the merits of the motion, as well as inquired into when WRHN would be able to provide additional details to Committee.

motions.item_title: N. Salonen motion from budget re: WRHN special levy
motions.text: Whereas the Province of Ontario requires municipalities to contribute a local share toward major hospital capital projects, and the forthcoming Waterloo Region Health Network (WRHN) hospital project is anticipated to require one of the largest municipal contributions in the Region’s history; Whereas early estimates indicate that the Region’s required local share will be in the multiple hundreds of millions, and this magnitude of investment will require long-term, disciplined financial planning; Whereas the Region of Waterloo must balance many competing and necessary capital priorities, and failing to begin reserving funds now would require significant future tax impacts or the deferral of other essential regional projects; Whereas establishing a dedicated, interest-bearing reserve fund enables the Region to gradually and responsibly accumulate contributions over multiple budget cycles, mitigating the need for sudden or unsustainable fiscal adjustments once the provincial approval process is finalized; Therefore be it resolved that: Council establish a Special Hospital Local Share Levy equivalent to 0.5% of the annual tax-supported budget, beginning in the 2026 fiscal year. All revenues collected through this Special Levy be directed to a newly created “Special Hospital Local Share Reserve Fund,” to be invested in accordance with the Region’s investment policy to allow funds to grow over time. The Special Hospital Local Share Reserve Fund be used exclusively for the municipal local share contribution required for the future WRHN hospital project and subsequently agreed upon Cambridge Hospital projects. Staff be directed to report annually during the budget process on the balance, growth, and projected trajectory of the Special Hospital Local Share Reserve Fund to ensure transparency and enable long-term planning. That staff bring back before budget 2027 the local share amount confirmed by the Province to Council, or continued suggestion for 2027 levy amount.
motions.text_html:
Whereas the Province of Ontario requires municipalities to contribute a local share toward major hospital capital projects, and the forthcoming Waterloo Region Health Network (WRHN) hospital project is anticipated to require one of the largest municipal contributions in the Region’s history; 
Whereas early estimates indicate that the Region’s required local share will be in the multiple hundreds of millions, and this magnitude of investment will require long-term, disciplined financial planning; 
Whereas the Region of Waterloo must balance many competing and necessary capital priorities, and failing to begin reserving funds now would require significant future tax impacts or the deferral of other essential regional projects; 
Whereas establishing a dedicated, interest-bearing reserve fund enables the Region to gradually and responsibly accumulate contributions over multiple budget cycles, mitigating the need for sudden or unsustainable fiscal adjustments once the provincial approval process is finalized; 

Therefore be it resolved that: 

  1. Council establish a Special Hospital Local Share Levy equivalent to 0.5% of the annual tax-supported budget, beginning in the 2026 fiscal year.
  2. All revenues collected through this Special Levy be directed to a newly created “Special Hospital Local Share Reserve Fund,” to be invested in accordance with the Region’s investment policy to allow funds to grow over time.
  3. The Special Hospital Local Share Reserve Fund be used exclusively for the municipal local share contribution required for the future WRHN hospital project and subsequently agreed upon Cambridge Hospital projects.
  4. Staff be directed to report annually during the budget process on the balance, growth, and projected trajectory of the Special Hospital Local Share Reserve Fund to ensure transparency and enable long-term planning.
  5. That staff bring back before budget 2027 the local share amount confirmed by the Province to Council, or continued suggestion for 2027 levy amount.

motions.item_title: N. Salonen motion from budget re: WRHN special levy
motions.text: That a special hospital local levy share equivalent to 0.5% of the annual tax-supported budget and spirit of the motion be referred to staff to bring forward into part of the 2027 base budget cycle. Further that this referral be brought forward regardless of if we have a final dollar amount agreed upon from the WRHN/Province.

Further that this referral be brought forward regardless of if we have a final dollar amount agreed upon from the WRHN/Province.
